title: Koi Aur Dawai?

lines.text: Two in the morning. A NICU, somewhere in India.
lines.spoken: Two in the morning. A N I C U, somewhere in India.
lines.hero: time and place, set big over a dim incubator silhouette; small tag ILLUSTRATIVE STORY

lines.text: A baby girl, nine days old. Born a little early. Fighting an infection in her blood.
lines.spoken: A baby girl, nine days old. Born a little early. Fighting an infection in her blood.
lines.hero: a tiny name-band card reading BABY OF ___, monitor line pulsing

lines.text: The culture report comes back. Resistant. Resistant. Resistant.
lines.spoken: The culture report comes back. Resistant. Resistant. Resistant.
lines.hero: a lab sheet; three red R stamps slam, one on each 'Resistant'

lines.text: Outside the glass, her mother has been standing for hours.
lines.spoken: Outside the glass, her mother has been standing for hours.
lines.hero: a pair of hands pressed to glass (illustration)

lines.text: She asks just one question. "Doctor, koi aur dawai hai?"
lines.spoken: She asks just one question. Doctor, koi aur dawai hai?
lines.hero: silence; only the monitor line; the question appears as burned caption

lines.text: Is there any other medicine?
lines.spoken: Is there any other medicine?
lines.hero: the doctor's empty hands; the drug shelf behind is bare

lines.text: Koi aur dawai?
lines.spoken: Koi aur dawai?
lines.hero: title, set huge, on black

lines.text: This story does not begin in the NICU. It begins in rooms like ours.
lines.spoken: This story does not begin in the N I C U. It begins in rooms like ours.
lines.hero: camera travels a long red string away from the NICU to a bright OPD desk

lines.text: A Monday OPD. Forty patients still waiting. Fever for three days, runny nose.
lines.spoken: A Monday O P D. Forty patients still waiting. Fever for three days, runny nose.
lines.hero: OPD token slip, set big

lines.text: "Doctor sahab, koi strong antibiotic de dijiye. Kal office jaana hai."
lines.spoken: Doctor sahab, koi strong antibiotic de dijiye. Kal office jaana hai.
lines.hero: the patient's stool beside the desk; burned caption only

lines.text: We know it is viral. We are tired. And saying no takes time we do not have.
lines.spoken: We know it is viral. We are tired. And saying no takes time we do not have.
lines.hero: a 10-second clock starts ticking

lines.text: Azithromycin. Three days. Next patient.
lines.spoken: Azithromycin. Three days. Next patient.
lines.hero: handwritten prescription slip, labelled RECREATION; the pen stroke lands on 'Next patient'

lines.text: Ten seconds. One signature. It felt like kindness.
lines.spoken: Ten seconds. One signature. It felt like kindness.
lines.hero: the signature on the slip, close

lines.text: Across India, that signature is written again and again.
lines.spoken: Across India, that signature is written again and again.
lines.hero: India map; slips multiply across it

lines.text: In a national survey of twenty hospitals, seven in ten admitted patients were on antibiotics.
lines.spoken: In a national survey of twenty hospitals, seven in ten admitted patients were on antibiotics.
lines.hero: ten bed icons; seven turn red

lines.text: More than half of them, just in case.
lines.spoken: More than half of them, just in case.
lines.hero: counter rolls to 55%

lines.text: Every dose that was not needed is a lesson. And bacteria never forget a lesson.
lines.spoken: Every dose that was not needed is a lesson. And bacteria never forget a lesson.
lines.hero: red string from every slip to one lab report

lines.text: In 2017, imipenem, one of our last-line drugs, still worked on about six in ten Klebsiella samples.
lines.spoken: In twenty seventeen, imipenem, one of our last-line drugs, still worked on about six in ten Klebsiella samples.
lines.hero: ICMR report page; a bar fills to 58%

lines.text: By 2023, barely one in three.
lines.spoken: By twenty twenty-three, barely one in three.
lines.hero: the bar falls to 36% on 'three'

lines.text: The man with the cold got better in a week. He always would have.
lines.spoken: The man with the cold got better in a week. He always would have.
lines.hero: the OPD slip, now crumpled

lines.text: But the bacteria stayed. In families. In wards. In our water.
lines.spoken: But the bacteria stayed. In families. In wards. In our water.
lines.hero: three small cards, one per word: home, ward, river

lines.text: And they found the ones who could not fight back.
lines.spoken: And they found the ones who could not fight back.

lines.text: A newborn. A mother after her C-section. A grandfather on a ventilator.
lines.spoken: A newborn. A mother after her C-section. A grandfather on a ventilator.
lines.hero: three illustrated cards, one per sentence (illustration, not real patients)

lines.text: They never asked for that antibiotic. They inherited what it left behind.
lines.spoken: They never asked for that antibiotic. They inherited what it left behind.
lines.hero: red string pulls tight from the OPD slip to all three cards

lines.text: Back in the NICU, her mother is still waiting for an answer.
lines.spoken: Back in the N I C U, her mother is still waiting for an answer.
lines.hero: camera returns along the string to the hands on the glass

lines.text: Every prescription we write today is our answer to her.
lines.spoken: Every prescription we write today is our answer to her.

lines.text: Antimicrobial stewardship is not a committee, or a circular. It is that answer.
lines.spoken: Antimicrobial stewardship is not a committee, or a circular. It is that answer.
lines.hero: the word STEWARDSHIP, set big on the pad

lines.text: Pause, and ask: is this really bacterial?
lines.spoken: Pause, and ask: is this really bacterial?

lines.text: Send the culture before the first dose.
lines.spoken: Send the culture before the first dose.
lines.hero: step card 2

lines.text: When the report comes, narrow the drug, and stop on time.
lines.spoken: When the report comes, narrow the drug, and stop on time.
lines.hero: step card 3

lines.text: For surgery, one dose. Not five days.
lines.spoken: For surgery, one dose. Not five days.

lines.spoken: And teach every patient: the red line on the strip means only with a prescription.

lines.text: AMR Awareness Week has ended. The bacteria did not take the week off.
lines.spoken: A M R Awareness Week has ended. The bacteria did not take the week off.
lines.hero: the week's card fades; the lab report stays lit

lines.text: This is not one more guideline to forward on WhatsApp and forget.
lines.spoken: This is not one more guideline to forward on WhatsApp and forget.
lines.hero: a forwarded-message card slides off the board

lines.text: It is ten seconds of courage. To explain. To wait. To say no.
lines.spoken: It is ten seconds of courage. To explain. To wait. To say no.
lines.hero: the 10-second clock from the OPD, now stopped

lines.text: So that one day, when a mother asks, "Koi aur dawai hai?"
lines.spoken: So that one day, when a mother asks, Koi aur dawai hai?

lines.text: we can still say: "Haan. Hai."
lines.spoken: we can still say: Haan. Hai.

fact_notes: STORY FRAME: the NICU baby, her mother, the doctor and the OPD patient are an ILLUSTRATIVE story, not real people. Tag the opening 'Illustrative story' and use illustration, never photos that look like real patients. The scenario is realistic: neonatal sepsis with multidrug-resistant Gram-negatives (Klebsiella, Acinetobacter) is well documented in Indian NICUs (e.g. the Delhi Neonatal Infection Study, Lancet Global Health 2016).
Lines 10, 5, 36-37: Hinglish on purpose. Record with a real person or an Indian English / Hindi voice. 'Haan. Hai.' = 'Yes. There is.'

Lines 15-16: NCDC multicentre point prevalence survey, 20 NAC-NET sites in 15 states and 2 UTs, WHO Global PPS method, 9,652 patients: 71.9% on antibiotics; 54.8% of them for prophylaxis; 91% of surgical prophylaxis patients received it for more than one day. Reported 2024 (Down To Earth; Rajya Sabha PQ 263, 6 Feb 2024).

Lines 18-19: ICMR AMRSN annual report 2023, as reported by Down To Earth: imipenem susceptibility of Klebsiella pneumoniae fell from 58.5% (2017) to 35.6% (2023). The data come from tertiary-care hospitals, not the community. Check against the ICMR PDF before the final render.
Line 21 'in our water': antibiotic residues and resistant bacteria in Indian rivers and wastewater are documented and are part of the One Health framing.
Line 31: WHO and ICMR surgical prophylaxis guidance is a single pre-incision dose, extended no more than 24 hours.
Line 32: MoHFW 'Red Line' campaign; Schedule H1, Drugs Rules 1945, in force since 1 March 2014.
Line 33: World AMR Awareness Week 2026, 18-24 November; theme 'One Health, one action: Prevent AMR now' (WHO).
